tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('main.go')
s = '''package main

import (
	\"crypto/rand\"
	\"fmt\"
	\"math/big\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	n, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(1<<31))
	if err "'!= nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	tmpl := template.Must(template.New("hello").Parse("Hello World {{.}}'"\\\\n\"))
	if err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, n); err "'!= nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
'"'''
tmp = p.with_suffix('.go.tmp')
with tmp.open('w') as f:
    f.write(s)
    f.flush()
    import os
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, p)
PY
gofmt -w main.go
git diff -- main.go go.mod go.sum"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat main.go && git status --short && git diff --no-index /dev/null main.go'
